analysis_plan.non_goals: no tuning; no re-run after viewing results; no claim of independent ground truth
analysis_plan.primary: per-detector confusion (TP/FP/FN/TN), precision, recall, F1, specificity, MCC on EVALUABLE mutants of effectiveness repositories; Wilson 95% CIs (mutant level, optimistic) and file-level cluster bootstrap 95% CIs for F1 (10,000 resamples, seed 20261004)
analysis_plan.robustness: parse/lex/model/detector exceptions on every .jcl file of every cloned repo (incl. mapa)

criteria.eligible_file: extension .jcl; >=1 JOB statement; >=2 EXEC steps; <=2000 lines; <=40 EXEC steps; not a duplicate of a development-corpus file (raw or normalised sha256); first occurrence kept inside the external pool
criteria.eligible_repo: licence text read at the pinned SHA; role=effectiveness
criteria.evaluation_units_note: extension scan only; extensionless/.prc/.cntl/.job members are not evaluation units (same rule as relic_eval/subjects.py)

design_decision_before_results: Decided BEFORE any detector or oracle output on any external file was produced (only the jcl_oracle lexer was used to count JOB/EXEC statements and lines; file/EXEC/line aggregates and file listings WERE seen, hence 'screened by aggregate counts/fragments', never 'blind'). (1) Evaluation unit = a .jcl file with >=1 JOB statement and >=2 EXEC steps, <=2000 lines, <=40 EXEC steps (bounded in-stream data / oracle cost). (2) Only repositories with a licence text read at the pinned commit are used; licence-unverified repositories are excluded from effectiveness metrics. (3) mapa jcl/testdata is synthetic parser-stress data: robustness counts only, no effectiveness metric. (4) Files whose raw or normalised sha256 equals a development-corpus file (datasets/) are excluded; within the external pool the first occurrence in (repo key, path) order is kept. (5) The frozen detectors (relic_v1_0, relic_v1_1, relic_v2) and the text baselines (textdiff, textdiff_ignore_job_parameters) are run exactly as defined in relic_eval/detectors.py and relic_eval/v2_eval.py; nothing is tuned or patched after results are seen; oracle/generator crashes are recorded as INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, detector errors as ERROR (scored as 'not flagged' and reported separately with an error-as-wrong bound). (6) Reported populations: pooled effectiveness; per repository; pooled without yetacp/mvs_sysgen (upstream-provenance sensitivity); leave-one-repository-out. With ~7 contributing repositories, no repository-level generalisation claim is made. (7) A negative or inconclusive outcome is reported as such.
exposure_statement: No external repository is blind. Agent 3 of the earlier sprint saw aggregate counts (and, for mapa/test0100.jcl and zopeneditor-sample/JCL/ALLOCATE.jcl, text fragments); this sprint's Agent 3 additionally saw file listings and lexer-level file/EXEC/line counts before the freeze. No oracle label or detector output on any external file had been produced at freeze time.
